question: Should this PR require a live exact-head node approval-unavailable transcript before merge, or may maintainers explicitly override that proof gate for this narrow recovery-copy change?
rationale: The implementation and focused Testbox validation are strong, but repository policy requires after-fix real behavior proof for an external non-docs PR, and the PR explicitly documents that no live run was collected.

options.title: Require live proof
options.body: Wait for redacted exact-head terminal output, logs, or a recording from a real node approval-unavailable run before merge.

options.title: Record proof override
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the focused exact-path coverage and narrow copy-only scope without a live run.

recommendation.title: Require live proof
recommendation.body: Wait for redacted exact-head terminal output, logs, or a recording from a real node approval-unavailable run before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the exact-head maintainer repair, reopened and protected the PR, and has the strongest recent history on the affected approval paths.
